title: Extra Health
description: This mod allows you to get extra health.
body: This mod adds a "Heart" item, crafted using 3 gold ingots in the top row of the crafting grid, two echo shards in each corner, a diamond on the bottom, lapis on the sides, and a nether star in the center. You can also use /redeemheart to get a heart back as an item. This is useful in servers, for health becoming currency.
